text: The initial synchronous create callback declares authPromise without an initial value. Only the OAuth and authentication-username branches assign it, but the later authPromise.then call is unconditional. If neither condition holds, that source path accesses undefined before returning the directory. Fixed accepted code instead initializes Promise.resolve and catches the subsequent fetch chain. Keep this conditional original-source issue separate from the reported test backout; server reachability and failure cause were not reproduced. Required primary numbered comment58 remains unavailable, with unknown author/type/body, so this is source-supported partial knowledge with zero full-audit credit.
title: The initial synchronous CardDAV create branch lacks a default authentication promise
